candidates.explanation: I think this is the most likely cause, but the snippet is truncated, so I couldn't see the code. The user is saved with provider 'google'. validateLogin then rejects them with needLoginViaProvider:google. AuthService.register doesn't pass a provider. So the default that UsersService.create applies when saving the entity must be wrong. It should be createUserDto.provider ?? AuthProvidersEnum.email. The error means it is probably set to google or some other non-email value.

This is a less likely cause. register spreads the DTO into usersService.create and doesn't set provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email. If the DTO or create default supplies another provider, the user is stored with it. Setting the provider explicitly here would remove that risk.

fix.description: In UsersService.create, make the saved provider default to email: provider: createUserDto.provider ?? AuthProvidersEnum.email. Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
